scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/main-window-frame-start.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
the full navigation wheel is open over a visible model in the MCAD Software
the user right-clicks the wheel and chooses Mini View Object Wheel
a small segmented circular wheel appears
the user right-clicks the wheel and chooses Mini Tour Building Wheel
a small segmented circular wheel remains visible
Mini Tour Building Wheel is marked as the selected layout
the user chooses Mini Full Navigation Wheel
a small circular wheel with more segments appears
Mini Full Navigation Wheel is marked as the selected layout
the user chooses Full Navigation Wheel
the model remains visible in the same apparent view
